notes: Structure-level supplement for the two formula-only cases in the 31-case paozhi holdout. The original 31-case file is unchanged. Reference structures are derived deterministically from tcm.db entries (no handwritten SMILES): atractyloside free acid by neutralising the dipotassium salt HBIN017299; THSG aglycone by hydrolysing the 2-O-glucosyl bond of HBIN003908. Target matching uses the 14-character InChIKey skeleton.
